decisions.reason: Core plural-component option with low carrying cost and unresolved niche demand supports keeping it.
Second resin injection variant remains a viable option given possible distinct customer segments.
Automatic spray gun is central to the firm's application portfolio and has low carrying cost.
Manual spray gun serves a broad established customer base and remains a valuable low-cost option.
Air-assisted airless gun complements the spray range and keeps a valuable option open.
Data logger is peripheral, received only a website mention, and with many other options the firm likely reallocates resources.
